name: TenderNed
notes: Primary Dutch procurement source. Search museum, exhibition, interpretation, interactive and visitor-experience notices.

name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
notes: Primary EU above-threshold procurement source; scheduled Scout supports the TED Search API.

name: Find a Tender
notes: Primary UK above-threshold source for live notices and planned procurement.

name: Contracts Finder
notes: UK procurement discovery, especially useful below Find a Tender thresholds.

name: Sell2Wales
notes: Strong source for exhibition, interpretation, immersive, interactive and AV opportunities.

name: Public Contracts Scotland
notes: Museum, heritage, exhibition design/build, interpretation and interactive technology.

name: eTenders Ireland
notes: Museum exhibition, visitor experience, design and multimedia procurement.

name: eTendersNI
notes: Museums, heritage, visitor experience, AV and exhibition production.

name: eVergabe Online
notes: Federal German exhibition, media-design and technical-implementation notices.

name: BOAMP
notes: French public procurement bulletin. Search musée, scénographie, multimédia, interactif and exposition.

name: PLACSP
notes: Spanish national procurement platform including tenders, preliminary market consultations and documentation.

name: ANAC / Italian public procurement
notes: Use for Italian museum fit-out, exhibition, multimedia and interactive procurement discovery; verify individual contracting-authority notices.

name: SIMAP
notes: Swiss public procurement search for museum, cultural and visitor-experience packages.

name: Doffin
notes: Norwegian official procurement database for museums, science centres and visitor attractions.

name: HILMA
notes: Finnish procurement notices and market-dialogue notices.

name: USP Ausschreibungssuche
notes: Central Austrian tender search, useful for museum and exhibition work.

name: Udbud.dk
notes: Danish current and expected procurement, prior notices and awards.

name: GeBIZ
notes: High-value source for Science Centre exhibit design/build, interactives, AR and AV.

name: India eProcure (CPPP)
notes: Useful for National Council of Science Museums immersive, multimedia and science-centre work.

name: South Africa eTenders
notes: National portal with science-centre, exhibit, AR/VR and interactive opportunities.

name: DCMS/Wolfson Museums and Galleries Improvement Fund
notes: Very early lead source. Awards target permanent displays, interpretation, accessibility and visitor-experience improvements; successful museums can become future exhibition/interactive prospects.

name: EU Culture & Creativity — Cultural Heritage Funding
notes: Tracks cultural-heritage funding across Creative Europe and other EU programmes. Use awarded/funded projects as early project signals, not as tenders.

name: EU Funding & Tenders / Horizon cultural heritage
notes: Search funded cultural-heritage and creative-industry projects for museums, digital heritage, interpretation and visitor-facing technology.

name: National Lottery Heritage Fund
notes: Monitor major museum, heritage and visitor-attraction awards. Funding announcements can precede exhibition and digital procurement by months or years.

name: ACE / ARCH-E Architecture Design Competitions
notes: Early-project source mapping architecture competitions and national competition ecosystems. Museum competition results and architect appointments are strong downstream procurement signals.

name: Architect & exhibition-design studio announcements
notes: Research agent should track museum/science-centre/visitor-centre project wins and appointments. Correlate architect or exhibition-designer appointments with funding and opening dates.

name: Planning applications & planning portals
notes: Search museum, gallery, science-centre and visitor-centre extensions, refurbishments and change-of-use applications. Planning approval is an early project-stage signal.

name: Council agendas, committee papers & capital programmes
notes: Track approvals, budgets, business cases, funding decisions and project milestones before procurement is published.

name: Museum annual reports, strategies & masterplans
notes: Search for gallery renewal, capital programme, new permanent exhibitions, digital interpretation and visitor-experience plans with future dates.

name: Individual museum procurement / supplier pages
notes: Discover and monitor buyer-specific tender, supplier and quotation pages. These can expose smaller specialist packages that never surface prominently on international aggregators.

name: Museum Insider
notes: Secondary museum-project and tender discovery. Always trace procurement claims to an authoritative source.

name: Tender Impulse
notes: Secondary discovery only. Use notice metadata to find the original procurement authority before classifying anything as Live Tender.

name: Custom RSS / Atom feeds
notes: For museum, heritage, architecture, funding and institutional procurement feeds.

name: In-Tend supplier portals
notes: Tender packs/submissions used by museum buyers including Science Museum Group.

name: Delta eSourcing
notes: Museum frameworks, exhibition build, AV and interpretation procurement documents.

name: ProContract / Due North
notes: Council and museum exhibit, visitor-experience and immersive-installation tenders.

name: SAM.gov
notes: US federal procurement source; API-key connector can be added later.

name: Web research agent
notes: Correlates funding → planning → architecture/masterplan → exhibition design → market engagement → tender → award/delivery. General web evidence may create Signal/Lead/Expected/Pre-market/Pitch only; Live Tender requires an official procurement source.
